tasks.title: Create apps/clipforge/ if absent and copy engine/'s full content into it as the starting point (it is a folder in this repo, not a template to 'generate' from). Add PROMPT_HISTORY/clipforge.md and seed apps/clipforge/BUILD_STATE.json. Commit + push immediately as push-access proof.
tasks.notes: apps/clipforge initialized from engine/, PROMPT_HISTORY/clipforge.md recorded, BUILD_STATE.json seeded.

tasks.title: Set identity inside apps/clipforge/: namespace/applicationId in app/build.gradle.kts (derive a safe package, e.g. com.forgebuild.clipforge), app_name in res/values/strings.xml.
Adaptive icon via apps/clipforge/tools/make_adaptive_icon.py (create artwork if none supplied). Commit + push.
Confirm the repo-level signing secrets exist (see SIGNING & RELEASES); do not regenerate them.
Implement the app described in APP_DESCRIPTION, ONE FEATURE PER COMMIT/PUSH STEP, following the per-step protocol and quality constraints above.

Validate the build configuration, then release clipforge-v1 (see SIGNING & RELEASES: dispatch release.yml with app_path=apps/clipforge) and verify the release + APK asset exist via the GitHub Releases API on vjumbo264/forgebuild.
Set apps/clipforge/BUILD_STATE.json build_complete: true only after clipforge-v1 is verified live.
